excluded.blocks: Server-derived from the model transcript (derive_blocks). The desktop reads blocks through readBlocks, never as a passthrough message field — restoring or syncing the derived form would double-source the timeline.
excluded.toolCalls: Server-side carrier (alias tool_calls). The derived blocks already carry the tool info the UI renders; restoring it too would render each tool twice.
excluded.interrupted: Server-written crash-recovery marker on user rows. The marker's own text carries the notice and no client field consumes the flag — restoring it would be a write-only field.
